newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sanyo Elec says will hit 96/97 business targets.
newsitem.headline: Sanyo Elec says will hit 96/97 business targets.

text.p: Sanyo Electric Co president Yasuaki Takano said on Friday that the company would be able to meet its business targets for the year to the end of March 1997.
"Business has been steady in the past nine months, and we will be able to post parent profits and sales this year as planned," Takano told a news conference.
In November, Sanyo said it expected to post a parent current profit of 28.5 billion yen and parent sales of 1.09 trillion yen for the 1996/97 year.
